item.text: [{"task_id":"e9afcf9a","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    period = int(round(params['pattern'][0]))","    row_step = int(round(params['pattern'][1]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if period <= 0:","        return out","    height, width = grid.shape","    for r in range(height):","        for c in range(width):","            source_row = (r + row_step * (c % period)) % height","            out[r, c] = grid[source_row, c]","    return out"],"shapes":{"pattern":[2]},"params":{"pattern":[2,1]},"rationale":"Alternate columns between the original row ordering and a cyclic shift by one row, producing a checkerboard of the two input colours.
